statement: Before claiming a change adds a refusal, run its refusal tests against main and record which already pass. Incident: cejel's audit C4 card asked `cejel issue` to refuse an attested generatedAt that is missing, malformed, or later than the issuer's clock. Run red on main, the missing and malformed cases already refused: the attestation schema requires an ISO 8601 generatedAt, and verifyWitanAttestationBinding runs before the reproduction. Only the future-time case was new. The new reader repeats the first two refusals as a second guard, behind a check that already refuses them, so a CLI test cannot reach it; a unit test covers it. Rule: commit the red run's per-test result, and in the CHANGELOG and hand-back name the refusals that existed before, rather than presenting every refusal as the change's own.
